component.name: Sistema Estelar Neural Adaptativo
component.purpose: Optional adaptive analysis capability coordinated by the existing SOUL control plane

transport.integration_pattern: registered N07 capability + bounded optional sidecar adapter

authority_boundaries.ethics_gate: SARA ETR + JEV guardrails; neural score is advisory, not authorization
authority_boundaries.regeneration_chain: SARA ARA -> ETR -> ITR with existing ERU/RGO/MMD evidence
authority_boundaries.persistence: Existing N01/SARA-owned boundaries; no second persistent-memory authority
authority_boundaries.compute_admission: Existing N07 SuperGPU/Octacore/Prefrontal controls; no independent SENA scheduler
authority_boundaries.signal_transport: Existing VagusBus; it is not a second Mesh
authority_boundaries.state_persistence: Existing HortaCore authority; do not duplicate it

resource_policy.overload_behavior: BLOCKED or UNMEASURABLE with evidence; original host path remains authoritative

memory_policy.checkpoint_policy: non-executable tensor/state format; reject untrusted pickle-based checkpoints

hard_gates: N07 capability is registered through the canonical Mesh contract
adapter and upstream revisions are explicitly pinned
runtime configuration and credentials are present
trace_id and correlation_id survive every hop
input and output hashes plus provenance are recorded
resource admission, queue limits, deadlines and cancellation are enforced
SARA ETR and applicable JEV guardrails accept decision-affecting outputs
SARA ARA->ETR->ITR and ERU/RGO/MMD evidence remain the governance authority
memory reads and writes respect N01/SARA ownership and retention policy
actual authenticated end-to-end evidence exists before state is marked REAL
all required CI and regression gates pass before promotion
human-approved rollback and kill-switch tests pass before production
prohibited_shortcuts: random tensors or invented sensor data used as production input
monkey-patching host methods as the integration contract
claiming idle-resource-only execution without RAM/VRAM/queue/deadline admission evidence
using model confidence as a substitute for semantic compatibility or ethical approval
allowing health checks or green CI alone to imply runtime execution is REAL
duplicating Mesh, HortaCore, VagusBus, SARA governance or persistent-memory authority
changing shared capability registries while related recovery/federation pull requests are unresolved

state_semantics.SPEC_ONLY: Contract/design exists; SENA runtime is not integrated or verified
state_semantics.PROJECTED: Adapter boundary is present but live authenticated execution is not proved
state_semantics.REAL: An authenticated end-to-end run produced verifiable outputs and provenance
state_semantics.BLOCKED: A required dependency, authorization, gate or runtime configuration is absent
state_semantics.UNMEASURABLE: Evidence is insufficient to determine behavior or resource use

source_inventory.note: Reuse registry entries and capability owners; do not copy upstream source trees or infer executability from registry presence
